designer_note: Output constants of the first-discovery rule (the condition is Rust code, ADR-0014 section 5). Discoverer = the single actor of the lowest (tick, sequence) MINERAL_MINED with quantity_kg > 0 for (world_id, star_system_id, mineral_id); no co-discovery; the ship joins as a second participant (vessel). The event is public, the original ship log is the discoverer's alone - the gap p2 claims, leaks and forgeries will live in. Changing any value here requires mineral-discovery@2. See docs/design/p1-02-mining-design.md section 4.
